name: Graphene Transport Explorer
description: A native multicore transport workbench for graphene devices: a field model (Ohmic FEM or viscous electron fluid) beside a semiclassical trajectory Monte Carlo with Klein tunnelling at p-n junctions, scattering laws, phonons and error bars. Hall, four-probe and EMR geometries, magnetic focusing, Veselago lenses, hydrodynamic devices, line sweeps and 2D maps, twelve worked examples with notes and references, and self-describing exports.
